name: RACE Stroke Scale
description: Rapid Arterial oCclusion Evaluation — 0-9, a total of 5 or more suggests a large vessel occlusion (LVO).

items.label: Facial palsy
items.follow_up: Any facial droop — ask them to smile?
items.jev_question: Facial palsy on examination. 0 = absent/symmetric smile, 1 = mild asymmetry, 2 = moderate-severe droop (one side barely or does not move).

items.label: Arm motor
items.follow_up: Can they hold both arms up for 10 seconds?
items.jev_question: Arm motor drift. 0 = normal or mild drift only, 1 = moderate (arm drifts down but shows some effort against gravity), 2 = severe (no effort against gravity, arm falls immediately).

items.label: Leg motor
items.follow_up: Can they lift each leg off the stretcher?
items.jev_question: Leg motor drift. 0 = normal or mild drift only, 1 = moderate (drifts down, some effort against gravity), 2 = severe (no effort against gravity).

items.label: Head & gaze deviation
items.follow_up: Are the eyes or head deviated to one side?
items.jev_question: Forced head and/or gaze deviation to one side. 0 = absent, 1 = present.

items.label: Aphasia / Agnosia
items.follow_up: Can they follow two commands / recognise their weak arm?
items.jev_question: Cortical signs: aphasia (if right-sided weakness — can they follow two simple commands?) or agnosia (if left-sided weakness — do they recognise their own weak arm and acknowledge the deficit?). 0 = normal/both tasks pass, 1 = one task failed, 2 = both tasks failed.

criteria.left: Weakness, droop, or drift is on the patient's left side
criteria.right: Weakness, droop, or drift is on the patient's right side
criteria.none_reported: No lateralized weakness described in the report

flag_questions.label: Seizure at onset
flag_questions.question: Did the patient have a witnessed seizure at symptom onset or during the exam (possible seizure mimic)?

flag_questions.label: Head trauma suspected
flag_questions.question: Is there any evidence or history of head trauma (fall, hit head, visible injury)?

flag_questions.label: On anticoagulant/antiplatelet
flag_questions.question: Is the patient on an anticoagulant or antiplatelet medication (blood thinner)?
